global: A rich, orange miso ramen broth glistens beneath a mound of shredded pork and crisp green onions. Served in a white bowl, the dish rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, orange-brown, glossy, speckled, with noodles and toppings visible beneath a mound of shredded white radish and green onions.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: pinkish-brown, tender-looking slice with slightly uneven surface and faint marbling.
